clue.text: Inattentive person in shelter arrested by agent with brain

indicators.note: something arrested is held in custody, so the shelter word is held inside the agent word

blocks.note: a secret agent is a spy
the lee is the sheltered side, away from the wind
your head holds your brain, so one stands for the other

explanation.surface: A daydreamer is sheltering somewhere when an intelligent spy catches them.
explanation.walkthrough: The lee is the side of a ship or wall away from the wind, which is why it means shelter.
explanation.definitionFit: A sleepyhead is a drowsy or dreamy person who is not paying attention, a familiar informal term.

clue.text: Leave cab, alas, bit damaged

indicators.note: damaged things are knocked out of shape, so the letters are put into a new order

blocks.note: the three words used letter for letter

explanation.surface: Someone abandons a taxi, lamenting that it is slightly dented.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Leave' looks like a verb telling you to walk away from the cab, but it is the noun: time off.
explanation.definitionFit: A sabbatical is a period of paid leave granted to academics or employees for study or travel.

clue.text: Medium in state having no time for tests

indicators.note: having none of something means it is taken out, here the time abbreviation
one item sitting in another is placed inside its letters

blocks.note: M is the clothing-size abbreviation for medium
an American state
T is the abbreviation for time

explanation.surface: A psychic medium in some state has no time left for tests.
explanation.walkthrough: TEXAS loses its T to give EXAS, and M goes inside.
explanation.definitionFit: Exams are formal tests of knowledge taken at school or university.

clue.text: Hesitation under pressure confuses crew in boat

indicators.note: in a down clue something placed under the rest sits at the bottom of the entry

blocks.note: P is the physics symbol for pressure
to addle is to muddle or confuse
a crew is a team working together
er is the sound of someone hesitating

explanation.surface: Someone dithering under pressure baffles the crew aboard a boat.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down clue, ER 'under' the rest puts it at the bottom: P, ADDLES, TEAM, then ER.
explanation.definitionFit: A paddle steamer is a steam-powered vessel driven by large paddle wheels, a kind of boat.

clue.text: Remake of The Saint? That's doubtful

indicators.note: a remake reworks the original material, so these letters are rebuilt in another order

blocks.note: the title used letter for letter

explanation.surface: A critic doubts the wisdom of remaking the TV show The Saint.
explanation.walkthrough: The Saint was a British TV series about a gentleman thief, also made into films.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone hesitant is unsure and wavering, so doubtful in manner.

clue.text: Inclined to keep book on rugby union short

indicators.note: keeping something means holding it, so these letters are held inside the first word
in a down clue one item placed on another sits directly above it

blocks.note: apt to do something means inclined to do it
B is the abbreviation for book
RU is the abbreviation for rugby union

explanation.surface: Someone tends to keep a rugby book brief.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down clue 'on' stacks the book above the rugby abbreviation, so both go in together.
explanation.definitionFit: An abrupt reply or manner is curt and brief, so short in the sense of brusque.

clue.text: Ruler treats army partially

indicators.note: only part of the following words is used, so the letters lie within them

blocks.note: spans the end of the first word and the start of the second

explanation.surface: A ruler shows favour to only part of the army.
explanation.definitionFit: The tsar was the emperor of Russia, an absolute ruler.

clue.text: Most unruly man communist suppressed

indicators.note: unruly things will not keep in order, so these letters are rearranged

blocks.note: taken as written
he is a man
red is the colour of communism

explanation.surface: A rebellious communist was crushed by the authorities.
explanation.definitionFit: To smother a feeling or uprising is to stifle or suppress it.

clue.text: Run and help attack

blocks.note: R is the cricket abbreviation for run
aid means help

explanation.surface: An instruction to rush over and assist with an attack.
explanation.definitionFit: A raid is a sudden assault on a place, so an attack.

clue.text: Panel uninterested in hearing

indicators.note: what is heard rather than read signals a word sounding like another

blocks.note: bored means uninterested

explanation.surface: A tribunal panel looks thoroughly bored during a hearing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Hearing' reads as a court session, fitting the panel, but it signals a sound-alike.
explanation.definitionFit: A board is a panel of people such as directors or examiners who make decisions together.

clue.text: Soil freshly broken by instrument, not one for volcanic island

indicators.note: something done freshly is made anew, so these letters are set out afresh
not having the word one means those letters are struck out
a word broken by another is split open with the other placed inside

blocks.note: taken as written
a brass instrument
taken as written

explanation.surface: Fresh soil turned over by a musician's instrument on a volcanic island.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Not one' removes the word itself from the instrument, not a single letter I.
explanation.definitionFit: Stromboli is an active volcano forming an island off the north coast of Sicily.

clue.text: Time consumed by renovation of top hotel, home for rock band

indicators.note: a renovation rebuilds what was there, so these letters are reordered
something consumed is taken inside, so this letter is placed within the others

blocks.note: the three words used letter for letter
T is the abbreviation for time

explanation.surface: A rock band spends its time doing up a top hotel to live in.
explanation.definitionFit: Mott the Hoople were an English glam rock group, best known for 'All the Young Dudes'.

clue.text: Playing at pub, lose desire to show rare musical ability

indicators.note: playing about with something means moving it around, so these letters are rearranged

blocks.note: the words used letter for letter
an itch is a restless desire

explanation.surface: A pub musician loses the urge to perform.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Playing at pub' paints a gig, but 'Playing' only rearranges the next words.
explanation.definitionFit: Absolute pitch, also called perfect pitch, is the uncommon ability to name or sing a note without a reference.

clue.text: Enjoy Welsh broadcast in church leader's name

indicators.note: broadcast means scattered widely, so these letters are spread into a new order

blocks.note: the two words used letter for letter

explanation.surface: Listeners enjoy a Welsh radio programme named after a church leader.
explanation.definitionFit: John Wesley was the eighteenth-century English cleric who founded Methodism, so his is a church leader's name.

clue.text: Popular chef's conclusion, exploiting filling

indicators.note: a conclusion is the end, so only the last letter of the word is used

blocks.note: in means fashionable or popular
the final letter of the word
using someone is exploiting them

explanation.surface: A popular chef finishes by making the most of a filling.
explanation.definitionFit: Infusing means filling or steeping something with a quality or flavour, as in infusing tea.

clue.text: Predictions about cutting wooded areas

indicators.note: a word cutting another slices into it, so it sits inside the other

blocks.note: forests are large wooded areas
CA is short for circa, about

explanation.surface: Forecasters predict tree-felling in the woods.
explanation.definitionFit: Forecasts are statements of what is expected to happen, such as weather predictions.

clue.text: Reset wobbly old record player

indicators.note: something wobbly is unsteady and out of place, so these letters shift into a new order

blocks.note: taken as written
O is the abbreviation for old

explanation.surface: Someone resets a wobbly old record player.
explanation.definitionFit: A stereo is a sound system for playing records and other audio through two speakers.

clue.text: Dish that's first of many set before us in Japanese city

indicators.note: first of means only the opening letter of the next word is used
one item placed in another sits inside its letters
set before means placed in front of what follows

blocks.note: the opening letter of the word
a major city in Japan
taken as written

explanation.surface: A dish, mostly put before visitors in a Japanese city.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Set before' places the first letter ahead of the city with us inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: Moussaka is a Greek baked dish of aubergine, minced meat and white sauce.

clue.text: Settled a craving

blocks.note: taken as written
greed is a craving for more

explanation.definitionFit: When terms are agreed they are fixed by mutual consent, so the matter is settled.

clue.text: Greek god's present identification acceptable

blocks.note: to pose a question is to present it
ID is short for identification
on means acceptable, as in 'that's not on'

explanation.surface: A Greek god presents valid identity papers.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Present' looks like a gift or the current time; it is the verb, to put forward.
explanation.definitionFit: Poseidon is the Greek god of the sea, earthquakes and horses.

clue.text: Hit barrier, getting over operation

indicators.note: in a down clue one item over another is placed directly above it

blocks.note: a wall is a barrier
op is short for operation

explanation.surface: A patient collides with a wall while recovering from surgery.
explanation.definitionFit: To wallop someone is to strike them hard, an informal verb for hit.

clue.text: Range, I note, a varied kind

indicators.note: something varied has been changed about, so these letters are mixed

blocks.note: a compass is a range or scope
the words used letter for letter

explanation.surface: Someone remarks on a broad and varied type of thing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Kind' looks like a noun for type after 'varied', but it is the adjective.
explanation.definitionFit: A compassionate person shows sympathy and concern for others, so is kind.

clue.text: Embrace and fuss, then part

blocks.note: ado is fuss
pt is the abbreviation for part

explanation.surface: Hug and make a fuss of someone, then say goodbye.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Embrace' suggests a hug, but here it means take up an idea.
explanation.definitionFit: To adopt an idea or cause is to take it up, the same sense as embrace a belief.

clue.text: Part of leg from young elephant

blocks.note: first meaning: the fleshy back of the lower leg
second meaning: the baby of an elephant, whale or cow

explanation.surface: Taking a piece of leg from a baby elephant.
explanation.definitionFit: The word names both the muscle at the back of the shin and the young of several large mammals.

clue.text: Atmosphere around street connected with trouble back in country

indicators.note: one word around another surrounds it
going back means read in the opposite direction

blocks.note: an aura is a distinctive atmosphere
St is the abbreviation for street
to ail is to trouble

explanation.surface: The atmosphere of a street linked with trouble back home in some country.
explanation.definitionFit: Australia is a country, the sixth-largest by area and also a continent.

clue.text: Move stealthily and softly, right beside bird

indicators.note: beside means placed next to, so the pieces sit side by side

blocks.note: p is the musical notation for piano, softly
R is the abbreviation for right
an owl is a bird

explanation.surface: A cat creeps quietly to sit next to a bird.
explanation.definitionFit: To prowl is to roam about quietly and furtively, as a predator hunting.

clue.text: Refrain from eating quickly

blocks.note: first meaning: go without food
second meaning: at speed

explanation.walkthrough: It reads as advice not to wolf your food; the two parts are separate meanings.
explanation.definitionFit: The word is both a verb for abstaining from food and an adverb meaning rapidly.

clue.text: Exercise involves a payment, it seems

indicators.note: something that involves another includes it, so those letters go inside

blocks.note: to exercise a skill is to apply it
taken as written
rent is a regular payment

explanation.surface: Taking exercise apparently costs money.
explanation.definitionFit: Apparently means as far as one can tell, the same hedge as saying it seems.
